_comment: Curated Dead family + tribute acts. Edit freely. The Worker uses `searchKeyword` to query Ticketmaster; the frontend uses everything else for cards + band pages. When adding an artist, also add its searchKeyword to worker/worker.js ARTISTS array.

artists.name: Dead & Company
artists.blurb: Bob Weir and Mickey Hart's post-Fare-Thee-Well configuration with John Mayer on guitar, Oteil Burbridge on bass, and Jeff Chimenti on keys. The biggest Dead-DNA touring act on Earth.

artists.name: Bob Weir
artists.blurb: Rhythm guitarist and co-founder of the Grateful Dead. Solo shows lean acoustic and storytelling.

artists.name: Bob Weir & Wolf Bros
artists.blurb: Bob Weir's trio with Don Was on upright bass and Jay Lane on drums, often augmented by horns. Loose, intimate, blues-leaning Dead.

artists.name: Phil Lesh
artists.blurb: Founding bassist of the Grateful Dead. Architect of the band's exploratory low end.

artists.name: Phil Lesh & Friends
artists.blurb: Phil's rotating-lineup project. Different guitarists, different setlists, same deep grooves — most often heard at Terrapin Crossroads alumni gigs.

artists.name: Mickey Hart Band
artists.blurb: Dead percussionist Mickey Hart's world-music-meets-jam-band ensemble. Polyrhythms front and center.

artists.name: Bill Kreutzmann
artists.blurb: Original Dead drummer. Tours with Billy & The Kids and the occasional one-off configuration.

artists.name: Billy & The Kids
artists.blurb: Bill Kreutzmann's quartet with Tom Hamilton, Aron Magner, and Reed Mathis. Highest-energy Dead-rooted show on the road.

artists.name: Dark Star Orchestra
artists.blurb: The gold standard of Dead tributes — each show recreates a specific Grateful Dead concert from history, with setlist and arrangement faithful to the source date. Touring since 1997.

artists.name: Joe Russo's Almost Dead
artists.blurb: JRAD. Drummer Joe Russo's reimagined-Dead supergroup — Marco Benevento, Tom Hamilton, Scott Metzger, Dave Dreiwitz. Tight, fast, modern arrangements of the catalog.

artists.name: Splintered Sunlight
artists.blurb: Philadelphia-based Dead tribute, gigging since 1990. The hometown band for any Delaware Valley Deadhead — frequent appearances at Ardmore Music Hall and the Keswick.

artists.name: China Cats
artists.blurb: Long-running Dead tribute working the East Coast theater + festival circuit.

artists.name: Cubensis
artists.blurb: Southern California's flagship Dead tribute since 1987. The longest-running on the West Coast.

artists.name: Half Step
artists.blurb: Northeast Dead tribute, Dead-of-the-80s era covers a specialty.

artists.name: Stella Blue's Band
artists.blurb: Dead tribute focused on the song-oriented Garcia ballad side of the book.

artists.name: Shakedown
artists.blurb: Dead tribute act. Common booking on the Northeast bar + small-theater circuit.

artists.name: The Schwag
artists.blurb: Midwest's longest-running Dead tribute — hosts the annual Schwagstock festival in Missouri.

artists.name: Terrapin Flyer
artists.blurb: Chicago-rooted Dead tribute, often joined by Grateful Dead alumni as guest sit-ins.

artists.name: Cosmic Charlie
artists.blurb: Athens, GA Dead tribute with a Southern-rock-tinged jam sensibility.

artists.name: Garcia Birthday Band
artists.blurb: Mid-Atlantic Dead/JGB tribute that grew out of annual Jerry Garcia birthday shows. The Jerry songbook gets equal billing with the Dead's.

artists.name: Reckoning
artists.blurb: Acoustic-leaning Dead tribute — focused on the 1980 Reckoning-era setlist territory.
